reports.title: Analog Devices Reports Record Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook for the First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027
section: For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, we are forecasting revenue of $4.4 billion, +/- $150 million. At the midpoint of this revenue outlook, we expect reported operating margin of approximately 40.3%, +/- 150 bps, and adjusted operating margin of approximately 50.5%, +/- 100 bps. We are planning for reported EPS to be $3.02, +/- $0.20, and adjusted EPS to be $3.82, +/- $0.20.

The adjusted results and adjusted anticipated results above are financial measures presented on a non-GAAP basis. Reconciliations of these non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are provided in the financial tables included in this release. See also the “Non-GAAP Financial Information” section for additional information.
